dedupe_keys.name: nantes chevire bridge road runoff macrolitter counts and mass 2020 2021

description: This dataset records macrolitter collected in a retention pond receiving runoff from an eight-hundred-metre section of the Chevire Bridge roadway in Nantes, France. Gustave Eiffel University researchers counted 36,439 items larger than one centimetre during ten campaigns between August 2020 and July 2021. Items are assigned to TSG-ML/OSPAR categories, with counts and dry masses totalling 88.5 kilograms. Mendeley version 4 supplies one Excel workbook free under CC BY 4.0. The roadway carries approximately ninety thousand vehicles daily and excludes pedestrians, so this site does not represent all urban litter sources. Collection through a retention pond and the study’s size threshold limit interpretation as total litter generation or microplastic loading. A reviewer-assessed use is constructing roadside pollutant-loading or drainage-maintenance scenarios. model-epa-swmm offers a related runoff simulation environment, although explicit litter transport would require additional assumptions. No workbook or loading calculation was inspected.
